metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a mosquito and somehow landed a kill? Valorant’s logic broke again
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I lost my mouse
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-shock
How did that even connect? No clue but I’m cashing in
Click if your aim bails you out of madness!

Tap if your aim sometimes ghosts you but still lands the shot!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykill #funnygaming #shorts
